title: Understand machine learning
description: Start with patterns, training, and generalization.

sources.title: A short introduction to machine learning

lessons.title: How models learn
lessons.concept: A model learns patterns from training examples. We keep some examples out of training to check performance on unseen data. Overfitting means memorizing training-specific details that do not generalize well.

questions.prompt: What does a model learn from?
questions.explanation: Training examples help a model find useful patterns.

questions.prompt: Why keep some examples out of training?

choices.text: To check performance on unseen examples
To teach the model every answer

questions.explanation: Held-out examples help estimate how well a model generalizes.

choices.text: Memorizing training details that do not generalize
Learning useful patterns on new examples
Using too few files on a phone

questions.explanation: Overfitting happens when training-specific details hurt performance on new examples.
